option.name: --adjust-vma
tip: Add OFFSET to all displayed section addresses.

option.name: --all-headers
tip: Display all headers.

option.name: --architecture
tip: Specify the target architecture.

option.name: --archive-headers
tip: Display archive header information.

option.name: --ctf
tip: Display CTF info from the section (default .ctf).

option.name: --ctf-parent
tip: Use the CTF archive member as the CTF parent.

option.name: --debug-dir
tip: Search the directory for debug info files.

option.name: --debugging
tip: Display debug information in the object file.

option.name: --debugging-tags
tip: Display debug information in ctags style.

option.name: --decompress
tip: Decompress sections before displaying them.

option.name: --demangle
tip: Decode mangled or processed symbol names.
STYLE can be none, auto, gnu-v3, java, gnat, dlang or rust.

option.name: --disassemble
tip: Disassemble executable sections.

option.name: --disassemble-all
tip: Disassemble all sections.

option.name: --disassemble-zeroes
tip: Do not skip blocks of zeroes when disassembling.

option.name: --disassemble=
tip: Disassemble starting from the given symbol.

option.name: --disassembler-color=
tip: Control disassembler color output.

option.name: --disassembler-options
tip: Pass text OPT to the disassembler.
Target-specific options are listed in objdump --help.

option.name: --dwarf
tip: Display the contents of DWARF debug sections.

option.name: --dwarf-check
tip: Make additional DWARF consistency checks.

option.name: --dwarf-depth
tip: Do not display DIEs at depth N or greater.

option.name: --dwarf-start
tip: Display DIEs starting at offset N.

option.name: --dynamic-reloc
tip: Display the dynamic relocation entries.

option.name: --dynamic-syms
tip: Display the dynamic symbol table contents.

option.name: --file-headers
tip: Display the overall file header.

option.name: --file-offsets
tip: Include file offsets when displaying information.

option.name: --file-start-context
tip: Include context from the start of the file (with -S).

option.name: --full-contents
tip: Display the full contents of requested sections.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this information.

option.name: --include
tip: Add DIR to the source file search list.

option.name: --info
tip: List supported object formats and architectures.

option.name: --inlines
tip: Print all inlines for a source line (with -l).

option.name: --insn-width
tip: Display WIDTH bytes on a single line for -d.

option.name: --line-numbers
tip: Include line numbers and filenames in the output.

option.name: --map-global-vars
tip: Display the memory mapping of global variables.

option.name: --no-addresses
tip: Do not print addresses alongside disassembly.

option.name: --no-recurse-limit
tip: Disable the demangling recursion limit.

option.name: --no-show-raw-insn
tip: Do not display hex alongside symbolic disassembly.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Add PREFIX to absolute paths for -S.

option.name: --prefix-addresses
tip: Print complete addresses alongside disassembly.

option.name: --prefix-strip
tip: Strip initial directory names for -S.

option.name: --private
tip: Display object-format-specific contents.

option.name: --private-headers
tip: Display object-format-specific file header contents.

option.name: --process-links
tip: Process non-debug sections in separate debuginfo files.

option.name: --recurse-limit
tip: Enable a demangling recursion limit (default).

option.name: --reloc
tip: Display the relocation entries.

option.name: --section
tip: Only display information for the named section.

option.name: --section-headers
tip: Display the section headers.

option.name: --sframe
tip: Display SFrame info from the section (default .sframe).

option.name: --show-all-symbols
tip: Display all symbols at a given address when disassembling.

option.name: --show-raw-insn
tip: Display hex alongside symbolic disassembly.

option.name: --source
tip: Intermix source code with disassembly.

option.name: --source-comment
tip: Prefix source code lines with the given text.

option.name: --special-syms
tip: Include special symbols in symbol dumps.

option.name: --stabs
tip: Display raw STABS information.

option.name: --start-address
tip: Only process data whose address is at least ADDR.

option.name: --stop-address
tip: Only process data whose address is below ADDR.

option.name: --syms
tip: Display the symbol table contents.

option.name: --target
tip: Specify the target object format.

option.name: --unicode
tip: Control the display of UTF-8 Unicode characters.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the program version.

option.name: --visualize-jumps
tip: Visualize jumps with ASCII art; optionally use color or disable.

option.name: --wide
tip: Format output for more than 80 columns.

option.name: -EB
tip: Assume big-endian format when disassembling.

option.name: -EL
tip: Assume little-endian format when disassembling.

option.name: -Wk
tip: Display sections linking to separate debuginfo files.

option.name: -WK
tip: Follow links to separate debug info files (default).

option.name: -WN
tip: Do not follow links to separate debug info files.
